body: Sedam i po is a very funny movie full of life but very real. You will have so much fun watching it. It depicts the humans not like "perfect-movie" characters but as real people. Their pain, their lives, their thoughts are all very real but still hilarious! The movie is not pretentious, it is down to earth. And it's humor as well! It is a specific type of humor, not shallow or ordinary "blockbuster" humor. It's a movie that allows viewer to come close to the character, root for him, laugh at him, pity him, despise or hate him. The humor lies in the reality of everyday life and the characters which are peculiar. Every story has a lesson but the lesson is not forced upon the viewer. I highly recommend it!

I liked it as there is some feeling of authenticity of Balkan vibe and some really good dialogue.

I would give it 10 if it only was 20mins shorter.

This movie is a pure masterpiece that will both make you laugh and cry at the same time. It is really showing all types of people that we are facing with in modern society (especially in Serbia) and it is represented creatively using the deadly sins from the bible.

Movie won four "Golden mimosa" awards at the 20th movie festival in Herzegovina; Miroslav Momcilovic for the script, Dimitrije Jokovic for the camera, Slavna Martinovic for the costume, and Branko Djordjevic for the sound.
